healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the Apify connector. Returns connector health status.

actors.list.title: List Actors
actors.list.description: List all Apify actors owned by the authenticated user. Supports pagination via limit and offset.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of actors to return (default 20, max 100).

offset.description: Optional. Number of actors to skip for pagination.
Offset used.

actors.get.title: Get Actor
actors.get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific Apify actor by its ID (e.g. username~actorName).

actorId.description: The actor ID in the format username~actorName (tilde-separated) or the actor's unique ID string.

actors.options.title: Actor Options
actors.options.description: List selectable actors for a picker: the account's own actors and saved tasks, plus Apify store results when a search term is supplied. Returns flat {id,label,source} options where id is the runnable actorId.

search.description: Optional. Store search term; when empty only account actors and tasks are returned.

actors.input_schema.title: Actor Input Schema
actors.input_schema.description: Fetch a specific actor's input schema (from its default build) so a UI can render the actor's runInput fields. Returns { schema } where schema is a JSON-Schema-style object.

actorId.description: The actor ID in the format username~actorName (tilde-separated) or the actor's unique ID.

actor.run.title: Run Actor
actor.run.description: Start a new run of a specific Apify actor asynchronously. Returns the run object immediately without waiting for completion.

actorId.description: The actor ID in the format username~actorName (tilde-separated) or the actor's unique ID.

runInput.description: Optional. The input JSON object to pass to the actor run.

memory.description: Optional. Memory limit for the run in megabytes (e.g. 256, 512, 1024).

timeout.description: Optional. Timeout for the run in seconds.

build.description: Optional. Tag or number of the actor build to run (e.g. 'latest').

maxItems.description: Optional. Maximum number of items the actor run should return.

actor.run_sync_get_dataset_items.title: Run Actor and Get Dataset Items
actor.run_sync_get_dataset_items.description: Run an Apify actor synchronously and immediately return the resulting dataset items. This is the primary 'scrape and get results' operation — it blocks until the actor finishes and returns all scraped data in one call.

actorId.description: The actor ID in the format username~actorName (tilde-separated) or the actor's unique ID.

runInput.description: Optional. The input JSON object to pass to the actor (e.g. {"startUrls": [{"url": "https://example.com"}]}).

memory.description: Optional. Memory limit for the run in megabytes.

timeout.description: Optional. Timeout in seconds. Maximum 300 for synchronous runs.

build.description: Optional. Tag or number of the actor build to run.

maxItems.description: Optional. Maximum number of dataset items to return.

items.description: Array of scraped dataset items returned by the actor.

runs.get.title: Get Run
runs.get.description: Retrieve details and current status of a specific Apify actor run by its run ID.

runId.description: The unique ID of the actor run to retrieve.

run.description: The actor run resource including status, timing, and dataset info.

runs.list.title: List Actor Runs
runs.list.description: List all runs for a specific Apify actor, ordered by most recent first. Supports pagination.

actorId.description: The actor ID in the format username~actorName (tilde-separated) or the actor's unique ID.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of runs to return.

offset.description: Optional. Number of runs to skip for pagination.

runs.abort.title: Abort Run
runs.abort.description: Abort a running Apify actor run. The run will be stopped and its status set to ABORTED.

runId.description: The unique ID of the actor run to abort.

run.description: The updated actor run resource with ABORTED status.

datasets.get.title: Get Dataset
datasets.get.description: Retrieve metadata and statistics for a specific Apify dataset by its ID.

datasetId.description: The unique ID of the dataset to retrieve.

datasets.items.title: Get Dataset Items
datasets.items.description: Retrieve items stored in a specific Apify dataset. Returns cleaned data in JSON format. Supports pagination.

datasetId.description: The unique ID of the dataset from which to retrieve items.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of items to return.

offset.description: Optional. Number of items to skip for pagination.

tasks.list.title: List Tasks
tasks.list.description: List all Apify actor tasks owned by the authenticated user. Tasks are saved configurations for running actors with specific inputs.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of tasks to return.

offset.description: Optional. Number of tasks to skip for pagination.

task.run.title: Run Task
task.run.description: Start a new run of a specific Apify actor task asynchronously. Returns the run object immediately.

taskId.description: The unique ID or username~taskName of the actor task to run.

runInput.description: Optional. Override input for this run. If omitted, the task's saved input is used.

task.run_sync_get_dataset_items.title: Run Task and Get Dataset Items
task.run_sync_get_dataset_items.description: Run an Apify actor task synchronously and immediately return the resulting dataset items. Blocks until the task run completes.

taskId.description: The unique ID or username~taskName of the actor task to run.

runInput.description: Optional. Override input for this run.

items.description: Array of dataset items returned by the task run.

key_value_store.get_record.title: Get Key-Value Store Record
key_value_store.get_record.description: Retrieve a single record (value) from an Apify key-value store by its store ID and record key.

storeId.description: The unique ID of the key-value store.

recordKey.description: The key of the record to retrieve (e.g. 'OUTPUT', 'INPUT').

value.description: The value stored at the given key. May be any JSON type or string.

datasets.list.title: List Datasets
datasets.list.description: List Apify datasets owned by the authenticated user. Supports pagination via limit and offset.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of datasets to return.

offset.description: Optional. Number of datasets to skip for pagination.

datasets.create.title: Create Dataset
datasets.create.description: Create a new Apify dataset. Optionally assign a unique name; unnamed datasets are also allowed.

name.description: Optional. Unique name for the dataset.

datasets.delete.title: Delete Dataset
datasets.delete.description: Permanently delete an Apify dataset and all of its items by dataset ID.

datasetId.description: The unique ID of the dataset to delete.
The ID of the deleted dataset.

datasets.push_items.title: Push Dataset Items
datasets.push_items.description: Append one or more JSON items to an Apify dataset.

datasetId.description: The unique ID of the dataset to append items to.

items.description: Non-empty array of JSON objects to store in the dataset.

key_value_stores.list.title: List Key-Value Stores
key_value_stores.list.description: List Apify key-value stores owned by the authenticated user. Supports pagination via limit and offset.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of stores to return.

offset.description: Optional. Number of stores to skip for pagination.

key_value_stores.get.title: Get Key-Value Store
key_value_stores.get.description: Retrieve metadata for a specific Apify key-value store by its ID.

storeId.description: The unique ID of the key-value store to retrieve.

key_value_store.put_record.title: Put Key-Value Store Record
key_value_store.put_record.description: Store a JSON value under a key in an Apify key-value store, creating or overwriting the record.

storeId.description: The unique ID of the key-value store.

recordKey.description: The key to store the value under (e.g. OUTPUT, INPUT).

value.description: JSON value to store at the given key.

key_value_store.list_keys.title: List Key-Value Store Keys
key_value_store.list_keys.description: List keys stored in an Apify key-value store, with optional exclusiveStartKey pagination.

storeId.description: The unique ID of the key-value store.

exclusiveStartKey.description: Optional. Return keys after this key (exclusive).

limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of keys to return.

nextExclusiveStartKey.description: Key to pass as exclusiveStartKey for the next page, or null.

key_value_store.delete_record.title: Delete Key-Value Store Record
key_value_store.delete_record.description: Delete a single record from an Apify key-value store by store ID and record key.

storeId.description: The unique ID of the key-value store.

recordKey.description: The key of the record to delete.

tasks.get.title: Get Task
tasks.get.description: Retrieve a specific Apify actor task by its ID, including saved input and run options.

taskId.description: The unique ID or username~taskName of the actor task.

users.me.title: Get Current User
users.me.description: Retrieve the authenticated Apify user profile, including username and account metadata.

webhooks.list.title: List Webhooks
webhooks.list.description: List Apify webhooks created by the authenticated user. Supports pagination via limit and offset.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of webhooks to return.

offset.description: Optional. Number of webhooks to skip for pagination.

runs.log.title: Get Run Log
runs.log.description: Retrieve the log output of a specific Apify actor run as plain text.

runId.description: The unique ID of the actor run whose log to retrieve.

request_queues.list.title: List Request Queues
request_queues.list.description: List Apify request queues owned by the authenticated user. Supports pagination via limit and offset.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of queues to return.

offset.description: Optional. Number of queues to skip for pagination.

actors.create.title: Create Actor
actors.create.description: Tool to create a new Actor with specified configuration. Use when you need to initialize a fresh Actor programmatically before publishing or running it. Maps Composio APIFY_CREATE_ACTOR onto Apify REST POST /v2/actors.

name.description: Unique name for the new actor (must be 1–63 characters, lowercase letters, digits, and dashes).

isPublic.description: Whether the actor should be publicly visible on Apify Store. Cannot be true on actor creation - actors must be created as private, then built and published later. Setting isPublic=true will result in a 403 error.

versions.description: Initial actor versions definition. Each item must include versionNumber, sourceType (string value like 'SOURCE_FILES' or 'INLINE', not an object), and buildTag.

categories.description: List of category IDs to which this actor belongs.

description.description: Detailed description of what the actor does.

isDeprecated.description: Whether the actor is deprecated (discouraged for new runs).

defaultRunOptions.description: Default execution options for running the Actor.

actors.update.title: Update Actor
actors.update.description: Tool to update Actor settings using JSON payload. Only specified fields will be updated. Use when you need to modify Actor configuration, make an Actor public, or update version settings. Maps Composio APIFY_ACT_PUT onto Apify REST PUT /v2/actors/{actorId}.

name.description: Actor identifier name. Only specified fields will be updated.

title.description: Display title for public actors. Required if isPublic is set to true.

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated owner's username and Actor name. Examples: 'Sbjr4vDajTluPyKl8' or 'apify~web-scraper'.

isPublic.description: Publication status. If set to true, title and categories are required.

categories.description: Classification tags for Apify Store. Required if isPublic is set to true.

description.description: Human-readable Actor details. Only specified fields will be updated.

taggedBuilds.description: Mapping of tag names to build references. Set to null to remove tag.

defaultRunOptions.description: Default execution settings for an Actor.

actors.delete.title: Delete Actor
actors.delete.description: Tool to delete an Actor permanently. Use when you need to remove an Actor by its ID or username~actorName. Confirm before calling. Maps Composio APIFY_DELETE_ACTOR onto Apify REST DELETE /v2/actors/{actorId}.

actorId.description: Unique identifier of the Actor to delete, in ID format or username~actorName format.

actors.webhooks.list.title: Get list of Actor webhooks
actors.webhooks.list.description: Tool to get a list of webhooks for a specific Actor. Use when you need to review or manage webhooks configured for an Actor. Maps Composio APIFY_ACT_WEBHOOKS_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/actors/{actorId}/webhooks.

desc.description: If true, sort by createdAt descending. Default is false (ascending).

limit.description: Maximum number of webhooks to return (pagination). Default and max is 1000.

offset.description: Number of webhooks to skip at the start (pagination). Default is 0.

actorId.description: Actor ID or '<username>~<actorName>' format to list webhooks for.

actors.versions.list.title: Get list of Actor versions
actors.versions.list.description: Tool to get the list of versions of a specific Actor. Use when you need to retrieve version metadata including source type, version number, and configuration details. Maps Composio APIFY_ACT_VERSIONS_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/actors/{actorId}/versions.

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated owner's username and Actor name (e.g., 'janedoe~my-actor' or 'nwua9Gu5YrADL7ZDj').

actors.versions.create.title: Create Actor Version
actors.versions.create.description: Tool to create a new version of an Actor. Use when you need to add a new version with specific source code location and configuration. Requires versionNumber and sourceType parameters, plus conditional parameters based on the sourceType. Maps Composio APIFY_ACT_VERSIONS_POST onto Apify REST POST /v2/actors/{actorId}/versions.

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated owner's username and Actor name.

envVars.description: Array of environment variables for the Actor version.

gitRepoUrl.description: URL of Git repository to clone. Required when sourceType is 'GIT_REPO'.

tarballUrl.description: URL of tarball or zip archive. Required when sourceType is 'TARBALL'.

sourceFiles.description: Array of source files. Required when sourceType is 'SOURCE_FILES'.

gitHubGistUrl.description: URL of GitHub Gist. Required when sourceType is 'GITHUB_GIST'.

applyEnvVarsToBuild.description: Whether to apply environment variables during build process. Defaults to false.

actors.versions.get.title: Get Actor version
actors.versions.get.description: Tool to get details about a specific version of an Actor. Use when you need version metadata including source type, build tag, and configuration details. Maps Composio APIFY_ACT_VERSION_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/actors/{actorId}/versions/{versionNumber}.

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated owner's username and Actor name (e.g., 'janedoe~my-actor' or 'nwua9Gu5YrADL7ZDj').

versionNumber.description: Actor major and minor version number (e.g., '0.1', '1.0').

actors.versions.update.title: Update Actor Version
actors.versions.update.description: Tool to update an Actor version's configuration and source code. Use when modifying version properties such as buildTag, sourceType, or environment variables. Only specified properties will be updated. Maps Composio APIFY_ACT_VERSION_PUT onto Apify REST PUT /v2/actors/{actorId}/versions/{versionNumber}.

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated owner's username and Actor name (e.g., 'janedoe~my-actor' or 'nwua9Gu5YrADL7ZDj').

envVars.description: List of environment variables with name, value, and optional isSecret properties.

buildTag.description: Build tag identifier to associate with this version.

gitRepoUrl.description: Git repository URL. Only used when sourceType is GIT_REPO.

tarballUrl.description: Tarball or Zip archive URL. Only used when sourceType is TARBALL.

sourceFiles.description: Array of source file objects with name, format (TEXT or BASE64), and content fields. Only used when sourceType is SOURCE_FILES.

gitHubGistUrl.description: GitHub Gist URL. Only used when sourceType is GITHUB_GIST.

versionNumber.description: Actor major and minor version number to update (e.g., '0.1', '1.0').

applyEnvVarsToBuild.description: Whether to apply environment variables during the build process.

actors.versions.delete.title: Delete Actor Version
actors.versions.delete.description: Tool to delete a specific version of an Actor's source code. Use when you need to remove an Actor version by actor ID and version number. Confirm before calling. Maps Composio APIFY_ACT_VERSION_DELETE onto Apify REST DELETE /v2/actors/{actorId}/versions/{versionNumber}.

actorId.description: Actor identifier in ID format or username~actorName format. Examples: '5fCDx7kGq9xcRt8FP' or 'john_doe~data-scraper'.

versionNumber.description: Actor version number to delete. Examples: '0.1', '1.0', '2.3'.

actors.versions.env_vars.list.title: Get list of Actor version environment variables
actors.versions.env_vars.list.description: Tool to get the list of environment variables for a specific Actor version. Use when you need to retrieve environment variable configurations for an Actor version. Maps Composio APIFY_ACT_VERSION_ENV_VARS_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/actors/{actorId}/versions/{versionNumber}/env-vars.

actorId.description: Actor ID or a tilde-separated owner's username and Actor name.

actors.versions.env_vars.create.title: Create Actor Version Environment Variable
actors.versions.env_vars.create.description: Tool to create an environment variable for a specific Actor version. Use when adding new environment variables to Actor versions. Requires name and value parameters. Maps Composio APIFY_ACT_VERSION_ENV_VARS_POST onto Apify REST POST /v2/actors/{actorId}/versions/{versionNumber}/env-vars.

actorId.description: Actor ID or a tilde-separated owner's username and Actor name.

isSecret.description: Indicates if the value is a secret. When true, the value will be omitted from responses. Defaults to false.

actors.versions.env_vars.get.title: Get Actor Version Environment Variable
actors.versions.env_vars.get.description: Tool to get environment variable details for a specific Actor version. Use when retrieving environment variable information from an Actor version. Returns name, value (if not secret), and secret status. Maps Composio APIFY_ACT_VERSION_ENV_VAR_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/actors/{actorId}/versions/{versionNumber}/env-vars/{envVarName}.

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated owner's username and Actor name (e.g., 'janedoe~my-actor' or 'flDZ3hqh45G99mwJu').

envVarName.description: The name of the environment variable to retrieve.

actors.versions.env_vars.update.title: Update Actor Version Environment Variable
actors.versions.env_vars.update.description: Tool to update environment variable for a specific Actor version using JSON payload. Only specified fields will be updated. Use when modifying existing environment variables in Actor versions. Maps Composio APIFY_ACT_VERSION_ENV_VAR_PUT onto Apify REST PUT /v2/actors/{actorId}/versions/{versionNumber}/env-vars/{envVarName}.

name.description: The environment variable name (must match envVarName).

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated owner's username and Actor name (e.g., 'janedoe~my-actor' or 'flDZ3hqh45G99mwJu').

isSecret.description: When set to true, the value will not be returned in subsequent requests. Only specified fields will be updated.

envVarName.description: The name of the environment variable to update.

actors.versions.env_vars.delete.title: Delete Actor Version Environment Variable
actors.versions.env_vars.delete.description: Tool to delete an environment variable from a specific Actor version. Use when removing environment variables from Actor versions. Maps Composio APIFY_ACT_VERSION_ENV_VAR_DELETE onto Apify REST DELETE /v2/actors/{actorId}/versions/{versionNumber}/env-vars/{envVarName}.

actorId.description: Actor ID or a tilde-separated owner's username and Actor name.

envVarName.description: The name of the environment variable to delete.

actors.builds.create.title: Build Actor
actors.builds.create.description: Tool to build an Actor with specified configuration. Use when you need to create a new build of an Actor with a specific version. The build process compiles the Actor's source code into a Docker image. Maps Composio APIFY_ACT_BUILDS_POST onto Apify REST POST /v2/actors/{actorId}/builds.

tag.description: Optional version tag specification for the build.

actorId.description: Actor ID or a tilde-separated owner's username and Actor name (e.g., 'janedoe~my-actor').

useCache.description: If true, uses cached layers from previous builds. Default: true.

betaPackages.description: If true, uses beta versions of Apify SDK packages. Default: false.

versionNumber.description: Actor version to build (e.g., '0.1'). If not provided, the latest version is used. Can be provided as query parameter or in request body.

waitForFinish.description: Optional timeout value (in seconds) to wait for build completion before returning response. Max 300 seconds.

actors.builds.list.title: Get list of builds
actors.builds.list.description: Tool to get a list of builds for a specific Actor. Use when you need paginated access to an Actor’s build (version) history. Maps Composio APIFY_GET_LIST_OF_BUILDS onto Apify REST GET /v2/actors/{actorId}/builds.

desc.description: If true, sort builds by creation date descending.

limit.description: Maximum number of builds to retrieve (pagination).

offset.description: Number of builds to skip (pagination).

actorId.description: Actor ID or '<username>/<actorName>' to list builds for.

unnamed.description: If true, return only unnamed builds.

waitForFinish.description: Seconds to wait for build to finish before returning.

actors.builds.default.title: Get Default Build
actors.builds.default.description: Tool to get the default build for an Actor. Use after specifying the Actor ID; optionally wait for the build to finish before returning. Maps Composio APIFY_GET_DEFAULT_BUILD onto Apify REST GET /v2/actors/{actorId}/builds/default.

actorId.description: Actor ID or owner's username and Actor name separated by tilde or slash (e.g. 'janedoe~my-actor' or 'janedoe/my-actor'). Both formats are accepted.

waitForFinish.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait synchronously for the build to finish. If omitted or 0, returns immediately with the current status.

actors.runs.last.title: Get last actor run
actors.runs.last.description: Tool to get the most recent run of a specific Actor. Use when you need to retrieve the last execution details of an Actor and optionally filter by status (e.g., status='SUCCEEDED' to get only the last successful run). Maps Composio APIFY_ACT_RUNS_LAST_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/actors/{actorId}/runs/last.

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated owner's username and Actor name (e.g., 'janedoe~my-actor').

actors.runs.last.dataset_items.title: Get Actor Last Run Dataset Items
actors.runs.last.dataset_items.description: Tool to get dataset items from the last run of an Actor. Use when you need to retrieve output data from the most recent Actor execution, optionally filtered by run status (e.g., status='SUCCEEDED' to get items only from the last successful run). Maps Composio APIFY_GET_ACTOR_LAST_RUN_DATASET_ITEMS onto Apify REST GET /v2/actors/{actorId}/runs/last/dataset/items.

bom.description: Include UTF-8 Byte Order Mark in response.

desc.description: If true, returns items in reverse order (newest to oldest).

omit.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude from each item.

view.description: Name of the dataset view to use.

clean.description: Shortcut for skipHidden=true and skipEmpty=true. When true, removes Apify-specific metadata and empty items.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. API has a limit of 250,000 items per request.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in each item.

offset.description: Number of items to skip from the start (pagination). Default is 0.

unwind.description: Field name to unwind array elements into separate items.

xmlRow.description: XML element name for each item (default: 'item').

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated owner's username and Actor name (e.g., 'janedoe~my-actor' or 'apify/hello-world').

flatten.description: Comma-separated list of fields to flatten.

skipEmpty.description: If true, skips empty items from results.

attachment.description: If true, forces 'Content-Disposition: attachment' in the response.

skipHidden.description: If true, skips fields beginning with '#' character.

skipHeaderRow.description: Skip header row in CSV format.

skipFailedPages.description: If true, excludes items with errorInfo property.

actor.run_sync.title: Run Actor Sync
actor.run_sync.description: Tool to run a specific Actor synchronously with input and return its output record. Use when immediate Actor results are needed; runs may timeout after 300 seconds. To avoid timeouts, scope inputs to specific URLs rather than broad crawls and request only necessary fields (e.g., text or markdown). Maps Composio APIFY_RUN_ACTOR_SYNC onto Apify REST POST /v2/actors/{actorId}/run-sync.

build.description: Build tag or number to run (default Actor's default build, usually 'latest').

input.description: JSON object passed as input to the Actor run.

memory.description: Memory limit in MB; power of two, minimum 128. Uses default if unset.

actorId.description: Actor ID or a tilde-separated owner and actor name (e.g., 'user~actor-name'). If provided with a forward slash (e.g., 'user/actor-name'), it will be automatically converted to the tilde format.

timeout.description: Run timeout in seconds. Uses Actor default if unset; HTTP wait max 300s.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of dataset items to return.

webhooks.description: Base64-encoded JSON array defining webhooks for run notifications.

outputRecordKey.description: Key of the record in the default key-value store to return (default 'OUTPUT').

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total charge in USD for the run. For pay-per-result actors, this parameter is required and must be at least $1.00. Officially documented for pay-per-event actors but also enforced by pay-per-result actors. Set this to control spending limits.

actor.run_sync_get.title: Run Actor Sync without Input (GET)
actor.run_sync_get.description: Tool to run a specific Actor synchronously without input and return its output. Use when immediate Actor results are needed without providing input data; the run must finish within 300 seconds otherwise the HTTP request fails with a timeout error. Maps Composio APIFY_ACT_RUN_SYNC_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/actors/{actorId}/run-sync.

build.description: Tag or number of the Actor build to run (e.g., 'beta' or '1.2.345'). Default: Latest configured build.

memory.description: Memory allocation for the Actor run in megabytes (e.g., 8192). Default: Memory limit specified in the default run configuration.

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated username~actorname format (e.g., 'janedoe~my-actor' or 'apify~hello-world').

timeout.description: Maximum run time in seconds. Zero value means no timeout. Default: Timeout specified in the default run configuration.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of dataset items that will be charged for pay-per-result Actors.

webhooks.description: Base64-encoded JSON array of webhook configurations to receive notifications for run events (ad hoc webhooks).

inputOverrides.description: JSON object to override Actor input. Sent as a query parameter encoded as JSON string.

outputRecordKey.description: Specifies which record from the Actor's key-value store to return. Must match a key produced by the Actor. Default: 'OUTPUT'.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum spending limit in USD for pay-per-event Actors. Accessible via environment variable.

actor.run_sync_get_dataset_items_get.title: Run Actor Sync & Get Dataset Items
actor.run_sync_get_dataset_items_get.description: Tool to run Actor synchronously and get dataset items. Supports both actors that require input and those that don't. Use when immediate access to Actor results is needed. The run must finish within 300 seconds otherwise the request times out. Maps Composio APIFY_ACT_RUN_SYNC_GET_DATASET_ITEMS_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/actors/{actorId}/run-sync-get-dataset-items.

bom.description: Include BOM (Byte Order Mark) in CSV output.

desc.description: Returns results in reverse order (newest to oldest).

omit.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude from each item.

build.description: Tag or number of the Actor build to run (e.g., 'beta' or '1.2.345').

input.description: JSON input object passed to the Actor. Actor-specific schema validation is performed server-side. IMPORTANT: Most Actors expect enum values in lowercase (e.g., 'relevance' not 'RELEVANCE', 'all' not 'ALL'). Check the Actor's documentation for exact input requirements.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in each item.

memory.description: Memory limit for the Actor run in megabytes.

offset.description: Number of items to skip from the start.

unwind.description: Field name to unwind array elements into separate items.

xmlRow.description: Customizes individual item XML element wrapper name.

actorId.description: Actor ID or username~actor-name format (e.g., 'apify~hello-world').

flatten.description: Comma-separated list of fields to flatten.

timeout.description: Timeout for the Actor run in seconds. Zero means no timeout.

xmlRoot.description: Customizes root XML element wrapper name.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of dataset items that will be charged for pay-per-result Actors.

attachment.description: Sets Content-Disposition: attachment header to force download.

skipHeaderRow.description: Skips header row in CSV output.

waitForFinish.description: Maximum time in seconds the server waits for the run to finish (0-60 seconds).

actor_builds.list.title: Get user builds list
actor_builds.list.description: Tool to get a paginated list of all builds for a user. Use when you need to retrieve build history across all actors. Supports pagination up to 1000 records. Maps Composio APIFY_ACTOR_BUILDS_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/actor-builds.

desc.description: If true, sort builds by startedAt descending. Default is ascending (false).

limit.description: Maximum number of builds to return (pagination). Maximum and default is 1000.

offset.description: Number of builds to skip at the start (pagination). Default is 0.

actor_builds.get.title: Get Actor Build
actor_builds.get.description: Tool to get detailed information about a specific Actor build. Use when you need to retrieve complete build details by build ID. Optionally wait for the build to finish using the waitForFinish parameter to avoid polling. Maps Composio APIFY_ACTOR_BUILD_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/actor-builds/{buildId}.

buildId.description: Unique identifier of the Actor build to retrieve.

waitForFinish.description: Number of seconds to wait synchronously for the build to finish. If omitted or 0, returns immediately with the current build status.

actor_builds.delete.title: Delete Actor Build
actor_builds.delete.description: Tool to delete an Actor build permanently. Use when you need to remove a specific build by its ID. The default build for an Actor cannot be deleted. Only users with build permissions can delete builds. Maps Composio APIFY_ACTOR_BUILD_DELETE onto Apify REST DELETE /v2/actor-builds/{buildId}.

buildId.description: Unique identifier of the Actor build to delete. The build that is the current default build for the Actor cannot be deleted.

actor_builds.abort.title: Abort Actor Build
actor_builds.abort.description: Tool to abort an Actor build that is starting or running. Use when you need to cancel a build in progress. Builds in terminal states (FINISHED, FAILED, ABORTING, TIMED-OUT) are not affected. Maps Composio APIFY_ACTOR_BUILD_ABORT_POST onto Apify REST POST /v2/actor-builds/{buildId}/abort.

buildId.description: Unique identifier of the Actor build to abort. Only builds in STARTING or RUNNING status will be aborted.

actor_builds.log.title: Get Actor Build Log
actor_builds.log.description: Tool to retrieve the log file for a specific Actor build. Use when you need to inspect logs generated during an Actor build process. Only the trailing 5 million characters of the log are stored. Maps Composio APIFY_ACTOR_BUILD_LOG_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/actor-builds/{buildId}/log.

raw.description: If true, the log includes formatting such as ANSI coloring sequences. If false (default), formatting is stripped.

stream.description: If true, enables streaming of log output progressively. Used by API clients for streaming responses.

buildId.description: Unique identifier of the Actor build. The endpoint authenticates using the buildId itself.

actor_builds.openapi.title: Get OpenAPI Definition
actor_builds.openapi.description: Tool to get the OpenAPI definition for a specific Actor build. Use when you need the API schema for code generation or analysis. Maps Composio APIFY_GET_OPEN_API_DEFINITION onto Apify REST GET /v2/actor-builds/{buildId}/openapi.json.

token.description: API authentication token. Only required for private Actors; public Actors can be queried without one.

actorId.description: Actor ID or tilde-separated owner's username and Actor name. Required when using 'default' as buildId.

buildId.description: ID of the build to retrieve, or 'default' for the default Actor build.

runs.delete.title: Delete Actor Run
runs.delete.description: Tool to delete a finished Actor run. Use when you need to permanently remove a completed run. Only finished runs can be deleted by the initiating user or organization. Maps Composio APIFY_ACTOR_RUN_DELETE onto Apify REST DELETE /v2/actor-runs/{runId}.

runId.description: Unique identifier of the Actor run to delete. Only finished runs can be deleted.

runs.update.title: Update Actor Run Status Message
runs.update.description: Tool to update the status message of an Actor run. Use when you need to set progress information or status updates that will be displayed in the Apify Console UI during Actor execution. Maps Composio APIFY_ACTOR_RUN_PUT onto Apify REST PUT /v2/actor-runs/{runId}.

runId.description: Run identifier for the Actor run to update.

statusMessage.description: Text displayed in Apify Console UI to communicate Actor progress.

isStatusMessageTerminal.description: Indicates whether the status message is the very last one (terminal status). If not provided, defaults to False.

runs.resurrect.title: Resurrect Run
runs.resurrect.description: Tool to resurrect a finished Actor run. Use when you need to restart a completed or failed run. Deprecated endpoint; may be removed in future. Maps Composio APIFY_RESURRECT_RUN onto Apify REST POST /v2/actor-runs/{runId}/resurrect.

runId.description: ID of the Actor run to resurrect.

runs.list_user.title: List User Actor Runs
runs.list_user.description: Tool to get a paginated list of all Actor runs for the authenticated user. Use when you need to browse all runs across all actors, optionally filtered by status or date range. Maps Composio APIFY_LIST_USER_RUNS onto Apify REST GET /v2/actor-runs.

desc.description: If true or 1 then the objects are sorted by the startedAt field in descending order. By default, they are sorted in ascending order.

limit.description: Maximum number of array elements to return. The default value (as well as the maximum) is 1000.

offset.description: Number of array elements that should be skipped at the start. The default value is 0.

status.description: Single status or comma-separated list of statuses to filter runs by. Available statuses: READY, RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, TIMING-OUT, TIMED-OUT, ABORTING, ABORTED.

startedAfter.description: Filter runs that started after the specified date and time (inclusive). The value must be a valid ISO 8601 datetime string (UTC).

startedBefore.description: Filter runs that started before the specified date and time (inclusive). The value must be a valid ISO 8601 datetime string (UTC).

runs.dataset_items.title: Get Run Dataset Items
runs.dataset_items.description: Tool to get dataset items from a specific Actor run. Use when you need to retrieve the output data from a completed or running Actor run. Maps Composio APIFY_GET_RUN_DATASET_ITEMS onto Apify REST GET /v2/actor-runs/{runId}/dataset/items.

bom.description: Include BOM (Byte Order Mark) in CSV output.

desc.description: If true, returns items in reverse order (newest to oldest).

omit.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude from each item.

clean.description: When true, removes any Apify-specific metadata from items.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Default depends on format.

runId.description: The unique identifier of the Actor run to retrieve dataset items from.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in each item.

offset.description: Number of items to skip from the start (pagination). Default is 0.

unwind.description: Field name to unwind array elements into separate items.

xmlRow.description: Customizes individual item XML element wrapper name.

flatten.description: Comma-separated list of fields to flatten.

xmlRoot.description: Customizes root XML element wrapper name.

skipEmpty.description: If true, skips empty items from results.

attachment.description: If true, forces 'Content-Disposition: attachment' in the response.

skipHidden.description: If true, skips fields beginning with '#' character.

skipHeaderRow.description: Skips header row in CSV output.

runs.default_dataset.title: Get Run Default Dataset
runs.default_dataset.description: Get Run Default Dataset. Maps Composio APIFY_GET_RUN_DEFAULT_DATASET onto Apify REST GET /v2/actor-runs/{runId}/dataset.

runId.description: Actor run ID whose default dataset metadata will be returned.

runs.default_key_value_store.title: Get Run Default Key-Value Store
runs.default_key_value_store.description: Get Run Default Key-Value Store. Maps Composio APIFY_GET_RUN_DEFAULT_KEY_VALUE_STORE onto Apify REST GET /v2/actor-runs/{runId}/key-value-store.

runId.description: Actor run ID whose default key-value store metadata will be returned.

runs.default_request_queue.title: Get Run Default Request Queue
runs.default_request_queue.description: Get Run Default Request Queue. Maps Composio APIFY_GET_RUN_DEFAULT_REQUEST_QUEUE onto Apify REST GET /v2/actor-runs/{runId}/request-queue.

runId.description: Actor run ID whose default request queue metadata will be returned.

tasks.create.title: Create Actor Task
tasks.create.description: Tool to create a new Actor task with specified settings. Use when you need to configure or schedule recurring Actor runs programmatically. Maps Composio APIFY_CREATE_TASK onto Apify REST POST /v2/actor-tasks.

name.description: Name of the task. Must contain only lowercase letters (a-z), digits (0-9), and hyphens (only in the middle). Names are automatically sanitized: spaces and special characters become hyphens, uppercase letters become lowercase.

actId.description: ID or 'username~actorName' of the Actor to attach the task to.

input.description: Input configuration for the task. This is the Actor-specific input data (e.g., keywords, URLs, settings). Keys must exactly match the target Actor's input schema; mismatched or extra keys cause INVALID_INPUT failures even when the API returns HTTP 200.

options.description: Task execution options such as memoryMbytes, timeoutSecs, build, diskMbytes. Note: Do NOT include 'input' here - use the separate 'input' field instead.

actorStandby.description: Actor standby configuration for faster task startup. When actorStandby is used, build, maxRequestsPerActorRun, desiredRequestsPerActorRun, idleTimeoutSecs, memoryMbytes, and shouldPassActorInput must be provided.

original_name.description: Internal field to store original name before sanitization.

tasks.update.title: Update Actor Task
tasks.update.description: Tool to update Actor task settings using JSON payload. Only specified properties are updated; others remain unchanged. Use when you need to modify task configuration, input, or execution options. Maps Composio APIFY_ACTOR_TASK_PUT onto Apify REST PUT /v2/actor-tasks/{actorTaskId}.

input.description: Input configuration for the task. Can be any JSON object or array with task-specific fields. Only specified fields will be updated.

title.description: Display title for the task. Only specified fields will be updated.

options.description: Task execution options (e.g., build, timeoutSecs, memoryMbytes, restartOnError). Only specified fields will be updated.

actorTaskId.description: Task ID (e.g., 'HG7ML7M8z78YcAPEB') or tilde-separated owner's username and task name (e.g., 'janedoe~my-task').

description.description: Description of the task. Only specified fields will be updated.

actorStandby.description: Actor standby configuration for faster task startup (request model).  When actorStandby is provided in a request, the API requires all 6 core fields: desiredRequestsPerActorRun, maxRequestsPerActorRun, idleTimeoutSecs, build, memoryMbytes, and shouldPassActorInput.  Note: isEnabled and disableStandbyFieldsOverride are response-only fields that cannot be sent in requests.

tasks.delete.title: Delete Actor Task
tasks.delete.description: Tool to delete an Actor task permanently. Use when you need to remove a task by its ID or username~taskName. Confirm before calling. Maps Composio APIFY_ACTOR_TASK_DELETE onto Apify REST DELETE /v2/actor-tasks/{actorTaskId}.

actorTaskId.description: Unique identifier of the Actor task to delete. Can be either the task ID (e.g., 'HG7ML7M8z78YcAPEB') or a tilde-separated username and task name (e.g., 'janedoe~my-task').

tasks.runs.last.title: Get last actor task run
tasks.runs.last.description: Tool to get the most recent run of a specific Actor task. Use when you need to retrieve the last execution details. You can filter by status to get only successful runs using status='SUCCEEDED'. Maps Composio APIFY_ACTOR_TASK_RUNS_LAST_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/actor-tasks/{actorTaskId}/runs/last.

actorTaskId.description: Task ID or '<username>~<taskName>' identifying the actor task.

tasks.runs.last.dataset_items.title: Get Task Last Run Dataset Items
tasks.runs.last.dataset_items.description: Tool to get dataset items from the last run of an Actor task. Use when you need to retrieve data from the most recent task execution. Filter by status (e.g., 'SUCCEEDED') to get items from the last successful run only. Maps Composio APIFY_GET_TASK_LAST_RUN_DATASET_ITEMS onto Apify REST GET /v2/actor-tasks/{actorTaskId}/runs/last/dataset/items.

bom.description: Include UTF-8 Byte Order Mark in response (default varies by format).

desc.description: Return results in reverse order (newest to oldest).

omit.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude from output.

view.description: Name of the dataset view to use.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (max: 250000).

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in output.

offset.description: Number of items to skip from the start (default: 0).

unwind.description: Field name to unwind array elements into separate items.

xmlRow.description: XML element name for each item (default: 'item').

flatten.description: Comma-separated list of fields to flatten.

attachment.description: Force browser download via Content-Disposition header.

actorTaskId.description: Task ID or '<username>~<taskName>' identifying the actor task.

skipHeaderRow.description: Skip header row in CSV format.

tasks.runs.list.title: Get list of task runs
tasks.runs.list.description: Tool to get a list of runs for a specific Actor task. Use when you need to paginate through task runs and optionally filter by status. Maps Composio APIFY_GET_LIST_OF_TASK_RUNS onto Apify REST GET /v2/actor-tasks/{actorTaskId}/runs.

desc.description: If true, sort by startedAt descending. Default is ascending.

limit.description: Maximum number of array elements to return. Default and max is 1000.

offset.description: Number of array elements to skip. Default is 0.

actorTaskId.description: Task ID or '<username>~<taskName>' identifying the task.

tasks.webhooks.list.title: Get list of task webhooks
tasks.webhooks.list.description: Tool to get a list of webhooks for a specific Actor task. Use when you need to review or paginate webhooks after creating or updating a task. Maps Composio APIFY_GET_LIST_OF_TASK_WEBHOOKS onto Apify REST GET /v2/actor-tasks/{actorTaskId}/webhooks.

desc.description: If true, sort by createdAt descending. Default is ascending.

limit.description: Maximum number of webhooks to return (pagination). Default and max is 1000.

offset.description: Number of webhooks to skip at the start (pagination). Default is 0.

actorTaskId.description: Actor task ID or '<username>~<taskName>' to list webhooks for.

tasks.input.get.title: Get Task Input
tasks.input.get.description: Tool to retrieve the input configuration of a specific task. Use when you need to inspect stored task input before execution or debugging. Maps Composio APIFY_GET_TASK_INPUT onto Apify REST GET /v2/actor-tasks/{taskId}/input.

taskId.description: Unique identifier of the Actor task to retrieve input for.

tasks.input.update.title: Update Task Input
tasks.input.update.description: Tool to update the input configuration of a specific Actor task. Use when you need to modify a scheduled tasks input before execution. Maps Composio APIFY_UPDATE_TASK_INPUT onto Apify REST PUT /v2/actor-tasks/{taskId}/input.

input.description: The new input configuration object for the task.

taskId.description: ID of the Actor task to update.

task.run_sync.title: Run Task Sync (POST)
task.run_sync.description: Tool to run an Actor task synchronously with input override and return its output. Use when immediate task results are needed with custom input parameters. The run must finish within 300 seconds otherwise the HTTP request fails with a timeout error (though the run continues server-side). Maps Composio APIFY_ACTOR_TASK_RUN_SYNC_POST onto Apify REST POST /v2/actor-tasks/{actorTaskId}/run-sync.

build.description: Specifies the Actor build to run (build tag or build number). By default, uses the build specified in task settings (typically 'latest').

memory.description: Allocated memory in megabytes for the actor execution. Overrides the task's default memory setting.

timeout.description: Timeout for the actor run in seconds. Overrides the task's default timeout setting.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of results that will be returned. Useful for limiting charges per result.

webhooks.description: Base64-encoded JSON array of webhook definitions for notifications on actor completion or failure.

actorTaskId.description: Unique identifier of the actor task to execute. Can be task ID or username~taskName format.

waitForFinish.description: Maximum number of seconds the server waits for the task run to finish (0-60 seconds; default is 0 for synchronous endpoints).

inputOverrides.description: JSON object containing input field overrides for the Actor task. Properties in this object override the task's default configuration. Any property not defined will use the default value from the task configuration or Actor's input schema.

task.run_sync_get.title: Run Task Sync (GET)
task.run_sync_get.description: Tool to run a specific task synchronously and return its output. Use when immediate task results are needed with pre-configured settings. The run must finish within 300 seconds otherwise the HTTP request fails with a timeout error. Maps Composio APIFY_ACTOR_TASK_RUN_SYNC_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/actor-tasks/{actorTaskId}/run-sync.

build.description: Tag or number of the actor build to run (e.g. 'beta' or '1.2.345'). Note: For tasks, this parameter typically has no effect as tasks already reference a specific Actor build.

memory.description: Allocated memory in megabytes for the actor execution.

timeout.description: Timeout for the actor run in seconds. Zero value means there is no timeout.

maxItems.description: Maximum dataset items charged for pay-per-result actors.

webhooks.description: Base64-encoded JSON array of webhook definitions for notifications on actor completion or failure.

actorTaskId.description: Unique identifier of the actor task to execute. Can be task ID or username~taskName format.

restartOnError.description: Determines whether the run will be restarted if it fails.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Specifies the maximum cost of the Actor run for pay-per-event actors.

task.run_sync_get_dataset_items_post.title: Run Task Sync with Input Override & Get Dataset Items
task.run_sync_get_dataset_items_post.description: Tool to run an actor task synchronously with input overrides and retrieve its dataset items. Use when you need to override task input configuration and get immediate results. The run must finish within 300 seconds otherwise the request times out. Maps Composio APIFY_ACTOR_TASK_RUN_SYNC_GET_DATASET_ITEMS_POST onto Apify REST POST /v2/actor-tasks/{actorTaskId}/run-sync-get-dataset-items.

desc.description: Return results in reverse order (newest to oldest).

omit.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude from output.

build.description: Tag or number of the build to run (e.g., 'latest', '1.2.3').

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Recommended for large scrapes to avoid excessive dataset sizes and costs.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in output.

memory.description: Memory allocation in megabytes for the task execution.

offset.description: Number of items to skip from the start (default: 0).

unwind.description: Field name to unwind array elements into separate items.

xmlRow.description: XML element name for each item (default: 'item').

timeout.description: Timeout for the run in seconds.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of dataset items that will be charged for pay-per-result Actors. Does not limit actual items returned.

webhooks.description: Base64-encoded JSON array of webhook definitions for notifications.

actorTaskId.description: Unique identifier of the actor task to execute (e.g., 'pPHi5vTiEhou0Nw5F').

waitForFinish.description: Maximum time to wait for the run to finish in seconds (max: 60).

inputOverrides.description: JSON object to override Actor input configuration. Properties not defined here use task defaults.

task.run_sync_get_dataset_items_get.title: Run Task Synchronously and Get Dataset Items
task.run_sync_get_dataset_items_get.description: Run a specific Actor task and return its dataset items. The run must finish within 300 seconds or the HTTP request fails with a timeout error. Maps Composio APIFY_ACTOR_TASK_RUN_SYNC_GET_DATASET_ITEMS_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/actor-tasks/{actorTaskId}/run-sync-get-dataset-items.

actorTaskId.description: Task ID or a tilde-separated owner's username and task's name.

timeout.description: Optional timeout for the run, in seconds. By default, the run uses the timeout from its configuration.

memory.description: Memory limit for the run, in megabytes. By default, the run uses the memory limit from its configuration.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of dataset items that will be charged for pay-per-result Actors. This does not guarantee the Actor returns only this many items.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total cost of the run. Use it to cap the amount charged for all pricing models.

build.description: Actor build to run. It can be a build tag or build number. By default, the run uses the build from its configuration.

webhooks.description: Base64-encoded JSON array of webhook definitions associated with the Actor run.

format.description: Format of the results. Possible values are json, jsonl, csv, html, xlsx, xml, and rss. The default is json.

clean.description: If true, return only non-empty items and skip hidden fields.

offset.description: Number of items that should be skipped at the start. The default is 0.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. By default there is no limit.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields which should be picked from the items.

outputFields.description: Comma-separated list of output field names that positionally rename the fields parameter.

omit.description: Comma-separated list of fields which should be omitted from the items.

unwind.description: Comma-separated list of array or object fields to unwind.

flatten.description: Comma-separated list of fields which should transform nested objects into flat structures.

desc.description: If true, return results in reverse order.

attachment.description: If true, the response sets Content-Disposition attachment.

delimiter.description: Delimiter character for CSV files, only used if format is csv.

bom.description: If true, include a UTF-8 byte order mark. Used with format csv.

xmlRoot.description: Root element name of xml output. The default is items.

xmlRow.description: Element name that wraps each item in xml output. The default is item.

skipHeaderRow.description: If true, skip the header row in csv format.

skipHidden.description: If true, skip hidden fields whose names start with #.

simplified.description: If true, apply the legacy fields and unwind used by Apify Crawler.

view.description: Dataset view name used to filter and present items.

skipFailedPages.description: If true, skip items that have an errorInfo property.

feedTitle.description: RSS channel title. Only used when format is rss.

feedDescription.description: RSS channel description. Only used when format is rss.

datasets.update.title: Update Dataset
datasets.update.description: Tool to update a dataset's name via JSON payload. Use when you need to rename an existing dataset. Maps Composio APIFY_DATASET_PUT onto Apify REST PUT /v2/datasets/{datasetId}.

datasetId.description: Dataset ID or username~dataset-name format to update.

datasets.statistics.title: Get Dataset Statistics
datasets.statistics.description: Tool to get dataset field statistics by dataset ID. Use when you need statistical information about dataset fields including min, max, null count, and empty count. Only provides field statistics when dataset schema is configured. Maps Composio APIFY_DATASET_STATISTICS_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/datasets/{datasetId}/statistics.

datasetId.description: Identifier of the dataset to retrieve statistics for (e.g., 'username~dataset-name' or dataset ID).

key_value_stores.create.title: Create Key-Value Store
key_value_stores.create.description: Tool to create a new key-value store or retrieve an existing one by name. Use when you need to initialize a store for saving data records or files. If a store with the given name already exists, returns that store instead of creating a duplicate. Maps Composio APIFY_KEY_VALUE_STORES_POST onto Apify REST POST /v2/key-value-stores.

name.description: Optional name for the key-value store. If provided, creates or retrieves a store with this name. If omitted, a random name is generated.

key_value_stores.delete.title: Delete Key-Value Store
key_value_stores.delete.description: Tool to delete a key-value store permanently. Use when you need to remove a key-value store by its ID. Confirm before calling. Maps Composio APIFY_KEY_VALUE_STORE_DELETE onto Apify REST DELETE /v2/key-value-stores/{storeId}.

storeId.description: Unique identifier of the key-value store to delete.

key_value_stores.update.title: Update Key-Value Store
key_value_stores.update.description: Tool to update a key-value store's properties. Use when renaming or changing access of the store after confirming the store ID. Maps Composio APIFY_UPDATE_KEY_VALUE_STORE onto Apify REST PUT /v2/key-value-stores/{storeId}.

name.description: New name for the key-value store.

storeId.description: Identifier of the key-value store to update.

key_value_store.head_record.title: Check Key-Value Store Record Exists
key_value_store.head_record.description: Tool to check if a record exists in a key-value store. Use when you need to verify whether a specific key exists in an Apify Key-Value Store without retrieving its content. Maps Composio APIFY_KEY_VALUE_STORE_RECORD_HEAD onto Apify REST HEAD /v2/key-value-stores/{storeId}/records/{recordKey}.

storeId.description: Identifier of the key-value store. Can be the store ID or username~store-name format.

recordKey.description: The key of the record to verify existence.

request_queues.create.title: Create Request Queue
request_queues.create.description: Tool to create a new request queue or retrieve an existing one by name. Use when you need to initialize a queue for storing and managing web scraping requests. If a queue with the given name already exists, returns that queue instead of creating a duplicate. Unnamed queues follow data retention period policies. Maps Composio APIFY_REQUEST_QUEUES_POST onto Apify REST POST /v2/request-queues.

name.description: Custom unique name to easily identify the queue in the future. If a queue with this name already exists, the existing queue object will be returned.

request_queues.get.title: Get Request Queue
request_queues.get.description: Tool to retrieve request queue metadata by queue ID. Use when you need information about a specific request queue including its statistics and request counts. Maps Composio APIFY_REQUEST_QUEUE_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/request-queues/{queueId}.

queueId.description: Unique identifier of the request queue to retrieve. Can be queue ID or 'username~queue-name' format.

request_queues.update.title: Update Request Queue
request_queues.update.description: Tool to update request queue name using JSON payload. Use when you need to rename an existing request queue. Maps Composio APIFY_REQUEST_QUEUE_PUT onto Apify REST PUT /v2/request-queues/{queueId}.

name.description: The new name for the request queue.

queueId.description: Unique identifier of the request queue to update. Can be queue ID or 'username~queue-name' format.

request_queues.delete.title: Delete Request Queue
request_queues.delete.description: Tool to delete a request queue permanently. Use when you need to remove a request queue by its ID. Maps Composio APIFY_REQUEST_QUEUE_DELETE onto Apify REST DELETE /v2/request-queues/{queueId}.

queueId.description: Unique identifier of the request queue to delete.

request_queues.head.title: Get Request Queue Head
request_queues.head.description: Tool to retrieve first requests from the queue for inspection. Use when you need to examine pending requests without locking them. Maps Composio APIFY_REQUEST_QUEUE_HEAD_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/request-queues/{queueId}/head.

limit.description: Maximum number of requests to return from the queue head. Must be >= 1.

queueId.description: Unique identifier of the request queue. Can be queue ID or 'username~queue-name' format.

clientKey.description: A client identifier used for tracking queue access by multiple clients. Used to determine cache consistency.

request_queues.head.lock.title: Get Head and Lock Queue Requests
request_queues.head.lock.description: Tool to get and lock head requests from the queue. Returns the given number of first requests from the queue and locks them for the given time, preventing other clients from accessing them during the lock period. Use when you need to process requests exclusively without concurrent access by other clients. Maps Composio APIFY_REQUEST_QUEUE_HEAD_LOCK_POST onto Apify REST POST /v2/request-queues/{queueId}/head/lock.

limit.description: Maximum number of requests to retrieve and lock from the queue head. Must be between 1 and 25. If not specified, returns all available unlocked requests.

queueId.description: Unique identifier of the request queue. Can be queue ID or 'username~queue-name' format.

lockSecs.description: How long the requests will be locked for, in seconds. Specifies the duration of the lock before it expires and the requests become available again.

clientKey.description: A unique identifier of the client accessing the request queue. Must be a string between 1 and 32 characters in length. Used to determine whether the queue was accessed by multiple clients.

request_queues.requests.list.title: List Request Queue Requests
request_queues.requests.list.description: Tool to list requests in a request queue with pagination support. Use when you need to retrieve multiple requests from an Apify request queue. Maps Composio APIFY_REQUEST_QUEUE_REQUESTS_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/request-queues/{queueId}/requests.

limit.description: Maximum number of requests to return per page.

queueId.description: Unique identifier of the request queue to list requests from. Can be queue ID or 'username~queue-name' format.

exclusiveStartId.description: All requests up to this one (including) are skipped from the result. Used for pagination to specify where to start fetching results.

request_queues.requests.add.title: Add Request to Queue
request_queues.requests.add.description: Tool to add a request to the queue. Use when you need to add a web page URL to a request queue for crawling. If a request with the same uniqueKey was already present in the queue, returns the ID of the existing request. Maps Composio APIFY_REQUEST_QUEUE_REQUESTS_POST onto Apify REST POST /v2/request-queues/{queueId}/requests.

url.description: URL of the web page to crawl.

headers.description: Object with HTTP headers where key is header name and value is the header value.

noRetry.description: When true, prevents automatic retry attempts on failure.

payload.description: HTTP request payload, e.g. for POST requests.

queueId.description: Unique identifier of the request queue. Can be queue ID or 'username~queue-name' format.

userData.description: Custom user data assigned to the request to save any request-related data to the request's scope, keeping them accessible on retries, failures, etc.

clientKey.description: A client identifier string between 1 and 32 characters. Used to determine whether the queue was accessed by multiple clients. If not provided, the system considers this API call to come from a new client.

forefront.description: Whether to add the request to the head (true) or the end (false) of the queue. When true, enables depth-first crawling; when false or omitted, enables breadth-first crawling.

handledAt.description: Timestamp of completion in ISO 8601 format.

uniqueKey.description: A unique key identifying the request for deduplication. Two requests with the same uniqueKey are considered as pointing to the same URL. If not provided, the URL is used as uniqueKey.

retryCount.description: Count of retry attempts following errors.

errorMessages.description: Collection of error descriptions from processing.

request_queues.requests.get.title: Get Request from Queue
request_queues.requests.get.description: Tool to retrieve a specific request from a request queue by its ID. Use when you need to get detailed information about a request in an Apify request queue. Maps Composio APIFY_REQUEST_QUEUE_REQUEST_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/request-queues/{queueId}/requests/{requestId}.

queueId.description: Unique identifier of the request queue containing the request.

requestId.description: Unique identifier of the specific request to retrieve from the queue.

request_queues.requests.update.title: Update Request in Queue
request_queues.requests.update.description: Tool to update a request in a request queue. Use when you need to modify request properties or mark a request as handled by setting handledAt to the current date/time. If handledAt is set, the request will be removed from the head of the queue and unlocked if applicable. Maps Composio APIFY_REQUEST_QUEUE_REQUEST_PUT onto Apify REST PUT /v2/request-queues/{queueId}/requests/{requestId}.

url.description: URL of the web page to crawl. Must be a non-empty string.

method.description: HTTP method (e.g., 'GET', 'POST'). Defaults to 'GET' if not specified.

headers.description: HTTP headers as key-value pairs. Key is header name, value is the value.

noRetry.description: The true value indicates that the request will not be automatically retried on error.

payload.description: HTTP request payload, e.g., for POST requests.

queueId.description: Unique identifier of the request queue, or username~queue-name format.

userData.description: Custom user data assigned to the request.

clientKey.description: Client identifier string between 1 and 32 characters in length.

forefront.description: Boolean determining queue position. If true, places request at the beginning of the queue. Default: false.

handledAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the request has been processed. Set to current date/time (e.g., '2025-12-06T14:42:30.000Z') to mark request as handled and remove from queue head. Is null if the request has not been crawled yet.

loadedUrl.description: The actual URL after any redirects occur.

requestId.description: Unique identifier of the request to update in the queue.

uniqueKey.description: A unique key identifying the request. Two requests with the same uniqueKey are considered as pointing to the same URL.

retryCount.description: Indicates the number of times the crawling of the request has been retried on error.

errorMessages.description: An array of error messages from request processing.

request_queues.requests.delete.title: Delete Request from Queue
request_queues.requests.delete.description: Tool to delete a specific request from a request queue. Use when you need to remove a request by its ID from an Apify request queue. Maps Composio APIFY_REQUEST_QUEUE_REQUEST_DELETE onto Apify REST DELETE /v2/request-queues/{queueId}/requests/{requestId}.

queueId.description: Unique identifier of the request queue.

requestId.description: Unique identifier of the request to delete from the queue.

request_queues.requests.lock.delete.title: Delete Request Lock
request_queues.requests.lock.delete.description: Tool to delete a request lock from a request queue. Use when you need to unlock a previously locked request. Only the client that locked the request can delete its lock. Maps Composio APIFY_REQUEST_QUEUE_REQUEST_LOCK_DELETE onto Apify REST DELETE /v2/request-queues/{queueId}/requests/{requestId}/lock.

queueId.description: Unique identifier of the request queue, or username~queue-name format.

clientKey.description: Unique client identifier (1-32 characters) used for lock/unlock operations. Must match the key that created the lock.

forefront.description: Determines queue position after lock removal. If true, request moves to head; if false, moves to end.

requestId.description: Unique identifier of the request whose lock should be deleted.

request_queues.requests.lock.prolong.title: Prolong Request Lock
request_queues.requests.lock.prolong.description: Tool to prolong request lock in a request queue. Use when you need to extend the lock duration on a previously locked request. Only the client that locked the request can prolong its lock. Maps Composio APIFY_REQUEST_QUEUE_REQUEST_LOCK_PUT onto Apify REST PUT /v2/request-queues/{queueId}/requests/{requestId}/lock.

queueId.description: Unique identifier of the request queue, or username~queue-name format.

lockSecs.description: Duration in seconds for how long the request lock will be prolonged.

clientKey.description: Unique client identifier (1-32 characters) used for lock authorization. Must match the key that created the original lock.

forefront.description: Determines if request should be added to the head of the queue or to the end after lock expires. If not specified, the request stays in its current position.

requestId.description: Unique identifier of the request whose lock should be prolonged.

request_queues.requests.batch_add.title: Batch Add Requests to Queue
request_queues.requests.batch_add.description: Tool to batch-add up to 25 requests to a request queue. Use when you need to add multiple requests efficiently. Failed requests due to rate limits should be retried with exponential backoff. Maps Composio APIFY_REQUEST_QUEUE_REQUESTS_BATCH_POST onto Apify REST POST /v2/request-queues/{queueId}/requests/batch.

queueId.description: Request queue ID or username~queue-name format.

requests.description: Array of requests to add to the queue (max 25 items). Each request must contain url, uniqueKey, and method fields.

clientKey.description: Unique identifier of the client accessing the request queue. Must be 1-32 characters.

forefront.description: Add requests to queue head (true) or end (false). Default: false

request_queues.requests.batch_delete.title: Batch Delete Requests from Queue
request_queues.requests.batch_delete.description: Tool to batch-delete up to 25 requests from a queue. Use when you need to remove multiple requests efficiently. Failed requests due to rate limits should be retried with exponential backoff. Maps Composio APIFY_REQUEST_QUEUE_REQUESTS_BATCH_DELETE onto Apify REST DELETE /v2/request-queues/{queueId}/requests/batch.

queueId.description: Unique identifier of the request queue.

requests.description: Array of requests to delete (max 25 items). Each request must contain either id or uniqueKey.

request_queues.requests.unlock.title: Unlock Queue Requests
request_queues.requests.unlock.description: Tool to unlock requests in a request queue that are currently locked by the client. If the client is within an Actor run, unlocks all requests locked by that specific run plus all requests locked by the same clientKey. If the client is outside of an Actor run, unlocks all requests locked using the same clientKey. Maps Composio APIFY_REQUEST_QUEUE_REQUESTS_UNLOCK_POST onto Apify REST POST /v2/request-queues/{queueId}/requests/unlock.

queueId.description: Unique identifier of the request queue containing the locked requests.

clientKey.description: Unique client identifier (1-32 characters) used for lock/unlock operations. If within an Actor run, unlocks all requests locked by that run plus those locked by this clientKey. If outside an Actor run, unlocks all requests locked by this clientKey.

schedules.list.title: Get list of schedules
schedules.list.description: Tool to get list of schedules created by the user. Use when you need to browse or enumerate user's schedules. Supports pagination with up to 1000 items per page. Maps Composio APIFY_SCHEDULES_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/schedules.

desc.description: Set to 1 to sort schedules by createdAt field in descending order (newest first). Default is 0 (ascending).

limit.description: Maximum number of schedules to return (pagination). Default and max is 1000.

offset.description: Number of items to skip at the start (pagination). Default is 0.

schedules.create.title: Create Schedule
schedules.create.description: Tool to create a new schedule with specified settings. Use when you need to automate Actor or Actor task execution at specific times using cron expressions. Maps Composio APIFY_SCHEDULES_POST onto Apify REST POST /v2/schedules.

name.description: The schedule's name (should be 3-63 characters long).

title.description: A human-friendly display title for the schedule.

actions.description: Actors or tasks that should be run on this schedule. Each action object specifies the type and target to run.

timezone.description: Timezone in which your cron expression runs (TZ database name format, e.g., 'UTC', 'America/New_York'). Defaults to UTC.

isEnabled.description: True if the schedule should be enabled.

isExclusive.description: When set to true, don't start Actor or Actor task if it's still running from the previous schedule.

cronExpression.description: The cron expression used by this schedule (e.g., '@monthly', '@daily', '0 0 * * *').

schedules.get.title: Get Schedule
schedules.get.description: Tool to get schedule details by ID. Use when you need to retrieve comprehensive information about a schedule including cron expression, timezone, actions, and execution times. Maps Composio APIFY_SCHEDULE_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/schedules/{scheduleId}.

scheduleId.description: Unique identifier of the schedule to retrieve.

schedules.update.title: Update Schedule
schedules.update.description: Tool to update an existing schedule with new settings. Use when you need to modify schedule properties like cron expression, timezone, enabled status, or actions. Only specified fields are updated; others remain unchanged. Maps Composio APIFY_SCHEDULE_PUT onto Apify REST PUT /v2/schedules/{scheduleId}.

name.description: The schedule's name (should be 3-63 characters long).

title.description: A human-friendly display title for the schedule.

actions.description: Actors or tasks that should be run on this schedule. Each action object specifies the type and target to run.

timezone.description: Timezone in which your cron expression runs (TZ database name format, e.g., 'UTC', 'America/New_York'). Defaults to UTC.

isEnabled.description: True if the schedule should be enabled.

scheduleId.description: Unique identifier of the schedule to update.

isExclusive.description: When set to true, don't start Actor or Actor task if it's still running from the previous schedule.

cronExpression.description: The cron expression used by this schedule (e.g., '@monthly', '@daily', '0 0 * * *').

schedules.delete.title: Delete Schedule
schedules.delete.description: Tool to delete a schedule by its ID. Use when you need to remove a schedule from the Apify system. Maps Composio APIFY_SCHEDULE_DELETE onto Apify REST DELETE /v2/schedules/{scheduleId}.

scheduleId.description: Unique identifier of the schedule to delete.

schedules.log.title: Get Schedule Log
schedules.log.description: Tool to get schedule log by ID. Use when you need to retrieve execution history for a schedule, including invocation timestamps and status messages. Returns up to 1000 invocations. Maps Composio APIFY_SCHEDULE_LOG_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/schedules/{scheduleId}/log.

scheduleId.description: Unique identifier of the schedule whose log you want to retrieve.

webhooks.create.title: Create Task Webhook
webhooks.create.description: Tool to create a webhook for an Actor task. Use when you need external notifications about task run events (e.g., completion or failure) in downstream systems. Maps Composio APIFY_CREATE_TASK_WEBHOOK onto Apify REST POST /v2/webhooks.

isAdHoc.description: If true, webhook is ad hoc (single dispatch).

condition.description: Condition object specifying actor or task IDs.

eventTypes.description: List of event types that trigger the webhook, e.g., ['ACTOR.TASK.RUN.SUCCEEDED'].

requestUrl.description: Target URL to which Apify will POST the webhook payload.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key to prevent duplicate webhook creation.

headersTemplate.description: JSON-like template for request headers. Some headers are managed by Apify.

payloadTemplate.description: JSON-like template for the POST body. Handlebars variables allowed.

shouldInterpolateStrings.description: Whether to interpolate variables inside strings in payloadTemplate.

webhooks.get.title: Get webhook
webhooks.get.description: Tool to get webhook object with all details. Use when you need to retrieve complete information about a specific webhook by its ID. Maps Composio APIFY_WEBHOOK_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/webhooks/{webhookId}.

webhookId.description: Unique identifier of the webhook to retrieve.

webhooks.update.title: Update Webhook
webhooks.update.description: Tool to update webhook using JSON payload. Only specified properties are updated; others remain unchanged. Use when you need to modify webhook settings like event types, target URL, or other configuration. Maps Composio APIFY_WEBHOOK_PUT onto Apify REST PUT /v2/webhooks/{webhookId}.

isAdHoc.description: Whether the webhook is ad-hoc (temporary, single dispatch).

condition.description: Webhook condition specifying which Actor, task, or run the webhook applies to.

webhookId.description: Unique identifier of the webhook to update.

doNotRetry.description: Whether to disable automatic retry on webhook delivery failure.

eventTypes.description: List of event types that trigger the webhook (e.g., ['ACTOR.RUN.SUCCEEDED', 'ACTOR.RUN.FAILED']).

requestUrl.description: Target URL to which Apify will POST the webhook payload.

headersTemplate.description: JSON-like template for request headers with variable substitution support.

ignoreSslErrors.description: Whether to ignore SSL certificate validation errors when delivering the webhook.

payloadTemplate.description: JSON-like template for the POST body with variable substitution support.

shouldInterpolateStrings.description: Whether to interpolate variables inside strings in payloadTemplate.

webhooks.delete.title: Delete Webhook
webhooks.delete.description: Tool to delete a webhook by its ID. Use when removing a webhook after confirming the webhook ID. Maps Composio APIFY_DELETE_WEBHOOK onto Apify REST DELETE /v2/webhooks/{webhookId}.

webhookId.description: Unique identifier of the webhook to delete.

webhooks.test.title: Test Webhook
webhooks.test.description: Tool to test a webhook by creating a test dispatch with a dummy payload. Use when you need to verify webhook configuration before production use. Maps Composio APIFY_WEBHOOK_TEST_POST onto Apify REST POST /v2/webhooks/{webhookId}/test.

webhookId.description: The unique identifier of the webhook to test. This webhook will receive a test dispatch with a dummy payload.

webhooks.dispatches.list.title: Get webhook dispatches
webhooks.dispatches.list.description: Tool to get list of webhook dispatches for a specific webhook. Use when you need to retrieve dispatch history for a particular webhook with pagination support. Maps Composio APIFY_WEBHOOK_WEBHOOK_DISPATCHES_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/webhooks/{webhookId}/dispatches.

desc.description: If true, sort by createdAt in descending order. Default is ascending.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (pagination). Default and max is 1000.

offset.description: Number of records to skip at the start (pagination). Default is 0.

webhookId.description: Unique identifier of the webhook to retrieve dispatches for.

webhook_dispatches.list.title: Get list of webhook dispatches
webhook_dispatches.list.description: Tool to get list of webhook dispatches for the user. Use when you need to retrieve webhook execution history with pagination support. Maps Composio APIFY_WEBHOOK_DISPATCHES_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/webhook-dispatches.

desc.description: If true, sort by createdAt in descending order. Default is ascending.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (pagination). Default and max is 1000.

offset.description: Number of records to skip at the start (pagination). Default is 0.

webhook_dispatches.get.title: Get Webhook Dispatch
