webhook_dispatches.get.description: Tool to get webhook dispatch object with all details. Use when you need to retrieve information about a specific webhook dispatch including its status, event data, and call history. Maps Composio APIFY_WEBHOOK_DISPATCH_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/webhook-dispatches/{dispatchId}.

dispatchId.description: The unique identifier for the webhook dispatch being queried.

users.get.title: Get Public User Data
users.get.description: Tool to get public user data. Use when you need to retrieve publicly accessible information about a specific Apify user account, similar to what can be seen on public profile pages. This operation requires no authentication token. Maps Composio APIFY_USER_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/users/{userId}.

userId.description: User identifier or username to retrieve public information for (e.g., 'apify', 'HGzIk8z78YcAPEB').

users.me.limits.get.title: Get Account Limits
users.me.limits.get.description: Tool to get a complete summary of account limits and usage. Use when you need to retrieve information about usage cycles, spending caps, compute resources, data transfer quotas, and other account limits. This shows the same information as the Limits page in Apify console. Maps Composio APIFY_USERS_ME_LIMITS_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/users/me/limits.

users.me.limits.update.title: Update Account Limits
users.me.limits.update.description: Tool to update account limits manageable on the Limits page. Use when you need to set or modify the monthly spending cap (maxMonthlyUsageUsd) or data retention period (dataRetentionDays). At least one limit parameter must be provided. Maps Composio APIFY_USERS_ME_LIMITS_PUT onto Apify REST PUT /v2/users/me/limits.

dataRetentionDays.description: Storage duration for historical data in days. Determines how long data persists before automatic deletion. The platform securely stores your ten most recent Actor runs indefinitely while other storages follow the retention period. Adjustable for subscribed users.

maxMonthlyUsageUsd.description: Monthly spending cap in USD. Controls overage charges by setting a hard limit on monthly platform usage. If your platform usage in the billing period exceeds the prepaid usage, you will be charged extra.

users.me.usage.monthly.title: Get Monthly Usage
users.me.usage.monthly.description: Tool to get monthly usage summary with daily breakdown. Use when you need detailed usage information including storage, data transfer, and request queue metrics for the current or a specific billing cycle. This shows the same information as the Billing page in Apify console. Maps Composio APIFY_USERS_ME_USAGE_MONTHLY_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/users/me/usage/monthly.

date.description: ISO date string to query usage for the billing cycle containing that date. If not provided, returns data for the current usage cycle. Format: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 date string.

store.list.title: Get list of Actors in Store
store.list.description: Tool to get list of public Actors from Apify Store. Use when you need to browse or search public Actors available in the store. Supports searching by title, name, description, username, and readme. Maps Composio APIFY_STORE_GET onto Apify REST GET /v2/store.

limit.description: Maximum number of Actors to return (pagination). Default is 10, maximum is 1000.

offset.description: Number of Actors to skip at the start (pagination). Default is 0.

search.description: Search string to filter Actors by title, name, description, username, and readme. Example: 'web scraper'

discover.g2_products.title: Discover G2 Products
discover.g2_products.description: Discover G2 Products. Runs store Actor fatihtahta/g2-scraper via POST /v2/acts/fatihtahta~g2-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_DISCOVER_G2_PRODUCTS).

maxProducts.description: Maximum matching software products to return.

searchQuery.description: Software product, category, or capability to search on G2.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

reports.carfax_by_vin.title: Get CARFAX Report by VIN
reports.carfax_by_vin.description: Get CARFAX Report by VIN. Runs store Actor easytools/carfax-report-by-vin via POST /v2/acts/easytools~carfax-report-by-vin/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_GET_CARFAX_REPORT_BY_VIN).

vinCodes.description: One or more 17-character alphanumeric VINs as a single VIN, comma/newline-separated text, or a JSON array encoded as text. The Actor uppercases and deduplicates VINs in first-seen order.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Required maximum total run charge in USD for availability checks or report purchases.

reports.us_fuel_price_averages.title: Get US Fuel Price Averages
reports.us_fuel_price_averages.description: Get US Fuel Price Averages. Runs store Actor crawlerbros/fuel-prices-scraper via POST /v2/acts/crawlerbros~fuel-prices-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_GET_US_FUEL_PRICE_AVERAGES).

maxItems.description: Fixed one-record limit for the national US aggregate.

fuelTypes.description: Fuel grades to include in the national average record.

includeHistory.description: Request historical comparison values; national records may include history even when false.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

includeChangeMetrics.description: Request price-change metrics when the Actor makes them available.

scrape.amazon_product_details.title: Scrape Amazon Product Details
scrape.amazon_product_details.description: Scrape Amazon Product Details. Runs store Actor delicious_zebu/amazon-product-details-scraper via POST /v2/acts/delicious_zebu~amazon-product-details-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SCRAPE_AMAZON_PRODUCT_DETAILS).

zipCode.description: Optional marketplace-local postal code for a precise delivery location.

products.description: Amazon ASINs or product detail URLs. Values may span marketplaces; duplicates are scraped and charged once.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

scrape.amazon_reviews.title: Scrape Amazon Reviews
scrape.amazon_reviews.description: Scrape Amazon Reviews. Runs store Actor axesso_data/amazon-reviews-scraper via POST /v2/acts/axesso_data~amazon-reviews-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SCRAPE_AMAZON_REVIEWS).

products.description: One or more independently configured Amazon products to scrape.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

scrape.booking_reviews.title: Scrape Booking Reviews
scrape.booking_reviews.description: Scrape Booking Reviews. Runs store Actor voyager/booking-reviews-scraper via POST /v2/acts/voyager~booking-reviews-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SCRAPE_BOOKING_REVIEWS).

cutoffDate.description: Oldest review date or documented relative date.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

scrape.facebook_ads.title: Scrape Meta/Facebook Ads
scrape.facebook_ads.description: Scrape Meta/Facebook Ads. Runs store Actor apify/facebook-ads-scraper via POST /v2/acts/apify~facebook-ads-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SCRAPE_FACEBOOK_ADS).

startUrls.description: Facebook Page or Meta Ad Library URLs. URL-encoded Ad Library filters take precedence over separate status and sorting inputs.

resultsLimit.description: Maximum ads returned per input URL. Omit to request every available ad; use maxTotalChargeUsd to bound charges.

isDetailsPerAd.description: Include available advertiser, spend, political-ad, EU audience, and reach details for each ad.

includeAboutPage.description: Include advertiser managing organization, admin-country, and page-history details when available.

onlyAdsNewerThan.description: Include ads active on or after YYYY-MM-DD or a positive relative period such as '2 months'.

onlyAdsOlderThan.description: Include ads active on or before YYYY-MM-DD or a positive relative period such as '2 months'.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD; this Actor requires at least $0.0058 when supplied.

enrichWithEcommerceData.description: Enrich product landing pages with product and price data. Each enriched product URL is an additional billable event, and one ad can contain multiple URLs.

scrape.facebook_comments.title: Scrape Facebook Comments
scrape.facebook_comments.description: Scrape Facebook Comments. Runs store Actor apify/facebook-comments-scraper via POST /v2/acts/apify~facebook-comments-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SCRAPE_FACEBOOK_COMMENTS).

startUrls.description: One to 50 public Facebook post URLs. Each URL is an independent comment source.

resultsLimit.description: Maximum top-level comments returned per source post, from 1 to 5,000. Replies are excluded because nested-comment expansion is always disabled. Provide this or maxTotalChargeUsd.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

scrape.facebook_events.title: Scrape Facebook Events
scrape.facebook_events.description: Scrape Facebook Events. Runs store Actor apify/facebook-events-scraper via POST /v2/acts/apify~facebook-events-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SCRAPE_FACEBOOK_EVENTS).

maxEvents.description: Maximum events per search query. Omit for no Actor-specific limit; use maxTotalChargeUsd separately to cap total run charges.

startUrls.description: Unique absolute facebook.com or fb.com event, event search, event explore, page-hosted-event, or group-event URLs.

searchQueries.description: Unique topic, place, or combined topic-and-place searches used to discover public events.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

scrape.facebook_group_posts.title: Scrape Facebook Group Posts
scrape.facebook_group_posts.description: Scrape Facebook Group Posts. Runs store Actor apify/facebook-groups-scraper via POST /v2/acts/apify~facebook-groups-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SCRAPE_FACEBOOK_GROUP_POSTS).

startUrls.description: Public Facebook group URLs whose posts should be scraped. Private groups are unsupported.

resultsLimit.description: Maximum posts returned for chronological sorting. Omit to scrape as many as available; this limit does not apply to every sort mode, so use maxTotalChargeUsd separately to cap total run charges.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

onlyPostsNewerThan.description: UTC cutoff as YYYY-MM-DD, an ISO date-time, or a relative duration such as '2 months'.

searchGroupKeyword.description: Optional public-group search text. Without login, words often return no results; one or two letters are recommended.

scrape.facebook_pages.title: Scrape Facebook Pages
scrape.facebook_pages.description: Scrape Facebook Pages. Runs store Actor apify/facebook-pages-scraper via POST /v2/acts/apify~facebook-pages-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SCRAPE_FACEBOOK_PAGES).

startUrls.description: Public Facebook pages to scrape for profile, contact, audience, and page metadata.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

scrape.facebook_photos.title: Scrape Facebook Photos
scrape.facebook_photos.description: Scrape Facebook Photos. Runs store Actor apify/facebook-photos-scraper via POST /v2/acts/apify~facebook-photos-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SCRAPE_FACEBOOK_PHOTOS).

startUrls.description: Public Facebook targets whose photo collections should be scraped.

resultsLimit.description: Maximum photo records to return across the supplied targets.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD; this Actor requires at least $0.0041 when supplied.

scrape.facebook_posts.title: Scrape Facebook Posts
scrape.facebook_posts.description: Scrape Facebook Posts. Runs store Actor apify/facebook-posts-scraper via POST /v2/acts/apify~facebook-posts-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SCRAPE_FACEBOOK_POSTS).

startUrls.description: One to 50 public Facebook page or profile URLs whose posts should be scraped.

resultsLimit.description: Maximum posts returned per source page or profile, from 1 to 5,000. Provide this or maxTotalChargeUsd.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

scrape.facebook_reels.title: Scrape Facebook Reels
scrape.facebook_reels.description: Scrape Facebook Reels. Runs store Actor apify/facebook-reels-scraper via POST /v2/acts/apify~facebook-reels-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SCRAPE_FACEBOOK_REELS).

searches.description: One or more independently configured Amazon product searches.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

search.booking_properties.title: Search Booking Properties
search.booking_properties.description: Search Booking Properties. Runs store Actor voyager/booking-scraper via POST /v2/acts/voyager~booking-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SEARCH_BOOKING_PROPERTIES).

checkIn.description: Check-in date or documented relative date.

checkOut.description: Check-out date or documented relative date.

maxItems.description: Maximum properties to return.

minScore.description: Minimum guest score from 0 to 10 as a string with at most one decimal place, matching the Actor's documented '8.4' format. The Actor warns that values below 5 may be inefficient.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

search.eventbrite_events.description: Search Eventbrite Events. Runs store Actor aitorsm/eventbrite via POST /v2/acts/aitorsm~eventbrite/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SEARCH_EVENTBRITE_EVENTS).

keyword.description: Required search keyword when category is custom.

maxResults.description: Soft result cap; the Actor may overshoot by about 200.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Required run charge cap in USD. The $0.0202 minimum covers the current highest-tier event charge ($0.02) plus the Actor's 4 GB start charge ($0.0002).

search.facebook_marketplace.title: Search Facebook Marketplace
search.facebook_marketplace.description: Search Facebook Marketplace. Runs store Actor apify/facebook-marketplace-scraper via POST /v2/acts/apify~facebook-marketplace-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SEARCH_FACEBOOK_MARKETPLACE).

resultsLimit.description: Maximum listings to return across inputs.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD; the Actor requires at least $0.0062.

search.google.title: Search Google
search.google.description: Search Google. Runs store Actor apify/google-search-scraper via POST /v2/acts/apify~google-search-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SEARCH_GOOGLE).

queries.description: One to ten Google queries separated by newlines; each query must contain no more than 32 words.

mobileResults.description: Use mobile rather than desktop organic search results.

maxPagesPerQuery.description: Maximum ordinary Google result pages per query; each page has about ten results.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD; this Actor requires at least $0.50 when supplied.

search.google_images.title: Search Google Images
search.google_images.description: Search Google Images. Runs store Actor hooli/google-images-scraper via POST /v2/acts/hooli~google-images-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SEARCH_GOOGLE_IMAGES).

queries.description: One to twenty Google Images search queries.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum image results returned for each query.

search.google_news.title: Search Google News
search.google_news.description: Search Google News. Runs store Actor data_xplorer/google-news-scraper-fast via POST /v2/acts/data_xplorer~google-news-scraper-fast/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SEARCH_GOOGLE_NEWS).

keywords.description: Google News keyword queries. Search operators such as site:, OR, quotes, and exclusions are supported.

topicUrls.description: Google News topic or section URLs for custom topic feeds.

decodeUrls.description: Resolve Google News redirects to publisher URLs; this increases run time.

maxArticles.description: Maximum articles per keyword, topic, or topic URL. Zero requests the Actor's documented unlimited mode.

extractImages.description: Fetch article images, including publisher og:image fallbacks.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration used by the Actor.

extractDescriptions.description: Fetch article-page descriptions; this increases run time.

search.google_shopping.title: Search Google Shopping
search.google_shopping.description: Search Google Shopping. Runs store Actor burbn/google-shopping-scraper via POST /v2/acts/burbn~google-shopping-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SEARCH_GOOGLE_SHOPPING).

limit.description: Maximum products to return from the requested page.

onSale.description: Only include products currently on sale.

stores.description: Optional comma-separated store names to include.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for localized results.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code for localized results.

freeReturns.description: Only include offers with free returns.

searchQuery.description: Product name, brand, or keywords to search on Google Shopping.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

search.instagram.title: Search Instagram
search.instagram.description: Search Instagram. Runs store Actor apify/instagram-search-scraper via POST /v2/acts/apify~instagram-search-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SEARCH_INSTAGRAM).

search.description: Keyword to search. Separate multiple terms with commas; searchLimit applies independently to each term.

liveSearch.description: Use live Instagram search instead of standard indexed sources. Live results can have a slightly different shape.

searchLimit.description: Maximum results per comma-separated search term. Instagram returns at most 250 per term; each returned item is chargeable.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

enhanceUserSearchWithFacebookPage.description: For the first ten profile results, also extract Facebook page data that can contain business contact details. Use only where collection is lawful.

search.jobs_across_sites.title: Search Jobs Across Sites
search.jobs_across_sites.description: Search Jobs Across Sites. Runs store Actor agentx/all-jobs-scraper via POST /v2/acts/agentx~all-jobs-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SEARCH_JOBS_ACROSS_SITES).

keyword.description: Job title, skill, or company query.

location.description: Optional city, area, or postal code.

platforms.description: Employer-hosted ATS platforms to search; limited to Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby.

max_results.description: Maximum job rows returned from each selected platform.

remote_only.description: Request remote-only jobs where the selected platform supports it.

posted_since.description: Optional absolute date or relative interval such as 24h, where supported.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

search.linkedin_companies.title: Search LinkedIn Companies
search.linkedin_companies.description: Search LinkedIn Companies. Runs store Actor harvestapi/linkedin-company-search via POST /v2/acts/harvestapi~linkedin-company-search/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SEARCH_LINKEDIN_COMPANIES).

maxItems.description: Maximum short company records to return across all searched pages.

startPage.description: First one-based LinkedIn company search page to scrape.

takePages.description: Maximum number of LinkedIn company search pages to scrape.

searchQuery.description: Company name or keywords to search for on LinkedIn.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

search.linkedin_jobs.title: Search LinkedIn Jobs
search.linkedin_jobs.description: Search LinkedIn Jobs. Runs store Actor harvestapi/linkedin-job-search via POST /v2/acts/harvestapi~linkedin-job-search/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SEARCH_LINKEDIN_JOBS).

page.description: Search page at which to start; each page contains 25 jobs.

company.description: Company names or full LinkedIn company URLs to include.

maxItems.description: Maximum jobs for each job-title and location input; 0 requests all available pages, up to 40 pages.

easyApply.description: Only jobs supporting LinkedIn Easy Apply.

jobTitles.description: LinkedIn job-search queries; each query runs separately and supports Boolean operators.

locations.description: LinkedIn locations applied to every job-title query.

workplaceType.description: Remote, hybrid, or on-site workplace filters.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD; this Actor requires at least $0.002 when supplied.

under10Applicants.description: Only jobs showing fewer than ten applicants.

search.linkedin_posts.title: Search LinkedIn Posts
search.linkedin_posts.description: Search LinkedIn Posts. Runs store Actor harvestapi/linkedin-post-search via POST /v2/acts/harvestapi~linkedin-post-search/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SEARCH_LINKEDIN_POSTS).

maxPosts.description: Maximum posts per query; 0 requests all available posts. LinkedIn generally exposes at most 400-500 posts per query. Use maxTotalChargeUsd separately to cap total run charges.

authorUrls.description: LinkedIn profile or company URLs whose authors posted or reposted the content.

maxComments.description: Maximum comments per post when comment scraping is enabled.

maxReactions.description: Maximum reactions per post when reaction scraping is enabled.

searchQueries.description: One to ten LinkedIn search queries. Each query is limited to 500 characters and five Boolean operators.

scrapeComments.description: Scrape comments. Each comment is charged as a separate result.

postedLimitDate.description: Inclusive oldest date as a JavaScript-compatible date-time string or millisecond timestamp.

scrapeReactions.description: Scrape reactions. Each reaction is charged as a separate result.

authorsCompanies.description: LinkedIn company names where post authors work.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

search.linkedin_profiles.title: Search LinkedIn Profiles
search.linkedin_profiles.description: Search LinkedIn Profiles. Runs store Actor harvestapi/linkedin-profile-search via POST /v2/acts/harvestapi~linkedin-profile-search/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SEARCH_LINKEDIN_PROFILES).

maxItems.description: Maximum profiles across all queries; 0 requests all available records, normally at most 2,500 per query.

lastNames.description: Last names to include; use the dedicated name action for exact person lookup.

startPage.description: First LinkedIn search page to scrape.

takePages.description: Search pages per query or per automatic segment; each page has up to 25 profiles.

firstNames.description: First names to include; use the dedicated name action for exact person lookup.

functionIds.description: LinkedIn function IDs, such as 8 for Engineering.

industryIds.description: LinkedIn industry IDs, such as 4 for Software Development.

searchQuery.description: Fuzzy LinkedIn people-search query; LinkedIn Boolean operators are supported.

pastJobTitles.description: Exact past job titles to include.

companyHeadcount.description: Current-company headcount bands A-I, from self-employed through 10,001+.

currentJobTitles.description: Exact current job titles to include.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD; this Actor requires at least $0.10 when supplied.

seniorityLevelIds.description: LinkedIn seniority IDs from trainee through owner/partner.

recentlyChangedJobs.description: Only profiles that changed jobs in the last 90 days.

yearsOfExperienceIds.description: LinkedIn experience bands: 1=<1 year through 5=>10 years.

autoQuerySegmentation.description: Split broad searches into smaller queries to exceed LinkedIn's 2,500-result query cap.

recentlyPostedOnLinkedIn.description: Only profiles that posted on LinkedIn in the last 30 days.

yearsAtCurrentCompanyIds.description: LinkedIn current-company tenure bands: 1=<1 year through 5=>10 years.

autoQuerySegmentationLevels.description: Country, state, seniority, or industry segmentation levels.

autoQuerySegmentationTargetCountries.description: Countries on which automatic query segmentation should focus.

search.linkedin_profiles_by_name.title: Search LinkedIn Profiles by Name
search.linkedin_profiles_by_name.description: Search LinkedIn Profiles by Name. Runs store Actor harvestapi/linkedin-profile-search-by-name via POST /v2/acts/harvestapi~linkedin-profile-search-by-name/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SEARCH_LINKEDIN_PROFILES_BY_NAME).

lastName.description: Person's last name. Supply a last name, a first name, or both; strictSearch requires exact matches for every supplied name.

maxItems.description: Maximum profiles; 0 requests all available records, up to 1,000 for one name query.

maxPages.description: Maximum search pages for this name query; each page has up to 10 profiles.

firstName.description: Person's first name. Supply a first name, a last name, or both; strictSearch requires exact matches for every supplied name.

strictSearch.description: Require exact matches for every supplied name field.

currentJobTitles.description: Exact current job titles to include.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD; this Actor requires at least $0.004 when supplied.

search.linkedin_profiles_by_services.title: Search LinkedIn Profiles by Services
search.linkedin_profiles_by_services.description: Search LinkedIn Profiles by Services. Runs store Actor harvestapi/linkedin-profile-search-by-services via POST /v2/acts/harvestapi~linkedin-profile-search-by-services/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SEARCH_LINKEDIN_PROFILES_BY_SERVICES).

search.description: Service or keyword query for LinkedIn profile discovery; LinkedIn Boolean operators are supported.

maxItems.description: Maximum profiles to scrape; 0 requests all available profiles.

takePages.description: Number of search pages to scrape. The README says 10 profiles per page, while the current OpenAPI description says 25.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD; this Actor requires at least $0.01 when supplied.

search.local_fuel_prices.title: Search Local Fuel Prices
search.local_fuel_prices.description: Search Local Fuel Prices. Runs store Actor johnvc/fuelprices via POST /v2/acts/johnvc~fuelprices/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SEARCH_LOCAL_FUEL_PRICES).

search.description: US ZIP code, city, or public location to search near.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Required total run charge cap because this Actor has no input-level result limit.

searchQueries.description: Keywords or names to search for in TikTok's public user search.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

maxProfilesPerQuery.description: Maximum public creator profiles to return for each search query.

maxItemsPerQuery.description: Maximum places per query or URL.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

search.upwork_jobs.description: Search Upwork Jobs. Runs store Actor neatrat/upwork-job-scraper via POST /v2/acts/neatrat~upwork-job-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items (Composio APIFY_SEARCH_UPWORK_JOBS).

query.description: Keywords to search in Upwork jobs.

perPage.description: Jobs requested per page; the Actor minimum is ten.

location.description: Upwork regions, subregions, or country names.

maxJobAge.description: Exclude jobs older than this value-and-unit duration.

pagesToScrape.description: Number of sequential pages to scrape.

fixedPriceRange.description: Minimum and maximum fixed-price budget in USD.

hourlyRateRange.description: Minimum and maximum hourly rate in USD.

paymentVerified.description: Optionally require or exclude clients with verified payment.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Maximum total run charge in USD accepted by the Actor run endpoint. Charges already incurred count toward monthly usage; Actor behavior at the cap depends on its pricing implementation.

query.description: Product query or Yandex Market URL.

maxItems.description: Maximum products to return.
